title: Fan Saved Stranger’s Life With Cancer Warning Note 😱
description:
How A Fan Warned A Man About Cancer 😮
During an NHL game, Kraken fan & med student Nadia Popovici spotted a suspicious mole on Vancouver Canucks equipment manager Brian “Red” Hamilton’s neck. Nervous but determined, she typed a huge note on her phone: “Get that checked — it could be melanoma.” Based on her own cancer experience, she showed it to the stranger… and changed his life forever.
He got tested immediately — it was early-stage melanoma. Doctors removed it in time. Both NHL teams honored Nadia with scholarships. This 2026-viral true story is the ultimate reminder that one brave moment can save a life.
